notes.title: Back to School Price Update!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! ✨ 

With back-to-school season here in Canada, I wanted to make it easier than ever to jump into Jirai’s adventure. Jirai the Red Panda is now available at a new discounted price! 🎒🍂

If you’ve been curious about Jirai’s journey to rescue his friends from the King Slime, now’s the perfect time to give it a try (or to recommend it to a friend who loves cozy adventures).

Thanks so much for all your support so far! It means the world to me. 💖 I can’t wait to hear what you think of Jirai’s adventure!


Grab the game, share your thoughts, and let’s make this fall an adventure together. 🐾

notes.title: Update Notes for April 18 2025!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Today I'm releasing the biggest update to Jirai the Red Panda to date! I've received a lot of great feedback since release and have been working away on adding some of it to the game! This is just the first of a couple planned updates to the game so look forward to more updates coming soon!

Updates:

Updated splash screen.
Updated UI to meet Colour blindness tests.
Added a Level Select menu so you can go back and play through levels in case you missed something.
Updated some of the slime enemies to be a little more forgiving/challenging.
Added a second check point to some of the levels that were longer so you don't have to redo the majority of a level.
Bug fixes.


Keep an eye out for more updates coming soon!

notes.title: Update for March 28th
notes.notes:
Red Panda's can climb walls right?
Adjusted tutorial level to include a section for wall jumping.

Bug Fixes

 Adjusted areas where Jirai wasn't able to progress properly.
 Adjusted Camera so that it should follow him a bit quicker especially when he's falling.

notes.title: Demo Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318148/1f122f68ce2dc0863f50a344cd21ee6ffbe2af97.png

Sorry for the inconvenience!! If you tried to play the demo there were some unfortunate bugs that were causing the slime minions not the work properly and Jirai was apparently immortal. These bugs have been solved and everything should be working as intended now!

Thanks for playing and staying interested! I can't wait for the full release at the end of March!
